purpose: Record the preregistered MLP15 component that survived prospective fourth-corpus transfer while the larger six-gain joint mediator program failed; do not recalibrate or rescue MLP17/interaction.
registered_component: pred_c_mlp15_transfer was separately preregistered at cosine >=0.75, relative L2 <=0.75, signs >=0.65 before fourth-corpus outcomes.

predictions.pred_a_immutable_registered_component: The v1 SHA, temporal seal, exact instrument, and fixed-price gates validate, and no new target statistic or threshold is introduced.
predictions.pred_b_mlp15_prospective_transfer: The immutable registered MLP15 gate is true on 512 fourth-corpus cells.
predictions.pred_c_both_unseen_templates_directional: Within each unseen template and direction, MLP15 prediction has positive cosine and sign agreement >=0.65; this descriptive split is not used to alter the registered overall gate.
predictions.pred_d_joint_failure_preserved: The parent remains a joint-mediator null; MLP17, interaction, and joint gains are not promoted or refit.
predictions.pred_e_zero_reopening_and_price: Zero GPU/model forwards, interventions, gradients, updates, fit operations, threshold changes, gain changes, or row filtering.

terminal_rule: screen only if all five statements hold; otherwise invalid/null.
